deadline.value: Fall entry application deadline is February 1; materials go through the Cardinal Landing portal.

gre_subject.value: The Human Bioenergetics admissions pages do not mention a GRE test.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact the Director of Graduate Studies before applying.
supervisor.quote: You are encouraged to contact Dr. Scott Trappe, strappe@bsu.edu for more information about the Human Performance Laboratory and associated research programs.

funding.value: Only applicants accepted with a stipend and tuition waiver are admitted, renewable for three years for PhD students.
funding.quote: Yes, we provide a stipend and tuition waiver for each Fall, Spring, and Summer.

also.quote: No, only those accepted to receive a stipend and tuition waiver are accepted into the program.

entry_route.value: A master's degree or higher from a USDE-recognized institution is required, with at least a 3.2 GPA from the master's-granting school.
entry_route.quote: You must have a master's degree or higher from an institution recognized by a USDE accrediting association.

notes: Mapped to Biomedical Sciences because the program is a PhD in human bioenergetics / exercise physiology in Kinesiology; the page does not use the word biomedical. Also requires two semesters of organic chemistry with lab. Program name: PhD in Human Bioenergetics.
name: PhD in Human Bioenergetics
